name: higgsfield
description: Higgsfield AI as one mod: cinematic image and video generation (Soul text-to-image, DoP image-to-video with named camera motions, Speak avatars) behind the mod protocol. BYOK throughout — every call spends the caller's own Higgsfield credits; the key pair (hf-api-key + hf-secret) is stored 0600 under ~/.mod/higgsfield and never in this repo. Generation is async upstream: submit returns a job-set id, poll it with job/wait until the artifact URLs land. One mod.py answers the m CLI and a small REST server off the same client, plus a raw escape hatch to any platform.higgsfield.ai route.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies
state: ~/.mod/higgsfield — key.json (0600: hf-api-key + hf-secret). Nothing private is ever written into this repo.

auth.upstream: hf-api-key + hf-secret headers on every platform.higgsfield.ai call
auth.byok: keys come from env (HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY / HIGGSFIELD_SECRET), per-call kwargs, or the 0600 keystore — in that order

endpoints.image: POST /image {prompt, ...params} — Soul text-to-image, returns a job-set
endpoints.video: POST /video {image_url, prompt, motion, model, ...} — DoP image-to-video
endpoints.motions: GET /motions — named camera motions for DoP
endpoints.raw: POST /raw {path, method, body} — any upstream route
